title: Privacy Policies & Terms of Service Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Evaluate privacy risks in terms of service agreements. Check for dark patterns, data collection practices, and consent management issues.
description: Assess the privacy risks and potential red flags in privacy policies and terms of service agreements. Our calculator helps you identify concerning clauses, dark patterns, and data collection practices that could impact your privacy.

inputs.label: Policy Length (in pages or screens)
inputs.helpText: Longer policies are often harder to understand and may hide concerning clauses

inputs.label: Reading Difficulty Level
inputs.helpText: Complex language can obscure important privacy implications

inputs.label: Types of Data Collected
inputs.helpText: Count personal info, browsing data, location, biometrics, contacts, etc.

inputs.label: Consent Management Quality
inputs.helpText: Poor consent mechanisms may indicate dark patterns

inputs.label: Data Retention Policy Clarity
inputs.helpText: Vague retention policies allow indefinite data storage

inputs.label: User Privacy Rights Mentioned
inputs.helpText: Access, deletion, portability, correction, objection, restriction, etc.

inputs.label: Policy Change Notification
inputs.helpText: Poor change notification can lead to unexpected privacy changes

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall privacy risk assessment (0-100, lower is better)

outputFields.label: Risk Grade
outputFields.description: Letter grade summarizing privacy risk level

outputFields.label: Primary Concerns
outputFields.description: Main privacy issues identified in the agreement

outputFields.label: Recommended Actions
outputFields.description: Steps to protect your privacy with this service

formula: const lengthRisk = Math.min(policyLength * 1.5, 30); const difficultyRisk = readingLevel === 'simple' ? 5 : readingLevel === 'moderate' ? 15 : 25; const dataRisk = dataTypes * 3; const sharingRisk = thirdPartySharing === 'none' ? 0 : thirdPartySharing === 'limited' ? 10 : thirdPartySharing === 'broad' ? 20 : 30; const consentRisk = consentMechanism === 'excellent' ? 0 : consentMechanism === 'good' ? 5 : consentMechanism === 'basic' ? 15 : 25; const retentionRisk = dataRetention === 'specific' ? 0 : dataRetention === 'general' ? 5 : dataRetention === 'vague' ? 15 : 20; const rightsBonus = Math.max(0, 15 - userRights * 2); const notificationRisk = changeNotification === 'direct' ? 0 : changeNotification === 'website' ? 5 : changeNotification === 'minimal' ? 10 : 15; const riskScore = Math.min(100, lengthRisk + difficultyRisk + dataRisk + sharingRisk + consentRisk + retentionRisk + rightsBonus + notificationRisk); const riskGrade = riskScore <= 25 ? 'A' : riskScore <= 40 ? 'B' : riskScore <= 60 ? 'C' : riskScore <= 80 ? 'D' : 'F'; let concerns = []; if (lengthRisk > 15) concerns.push('Excessively long policy'); if (difficultyRisk > 15) concerns.push('Complex legal language'); if (dataRisk > 15) concerns.push('Extensive data collection'); if (sharingRisk > 15) concerns.push('Broad third-party sharing'); if (consentRisk > 10) concerns.push('Poor consent mechanisms'); if (retentionRisk > 10) concerns.push('Unclear data retention'); if (rightsBonus > 10) concerns.push('Limited user rights'); const primaryConcerns = concerns.length > 0 ? concerns.join(', ') : 'No major concerns identified'; let actions = []; if (riskScore > 60) actions.push('Consider avoiding this service if possible'); if (consentRisk > 10) actions.push('Review all consent options carefully'); if (sharingRisk > 15) actions.push('Use Incognito Browser to limit tracking'); if (dataRisk > 15) actions.push('Minimize data sharing in account settings'); actions.push('Regularly review and update privacy settings'); const recommendedActions = actions.join('; '); return { riskScore, riskGrade, primaryConcerns, recommendedActions };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates privacy policies and terms of service based on key risk factors including policy complexity, data collection scope, sharing practices, consent mechanisms, and user rights. The assessment helps identify potential privacy risks and dark patterns commonly found in legal agreements.
tips: Always read privacy policies before accepting, even if they're long
Look for specific data retention timeframes rather than vague language
Check if the service offers granular privacy controls and consent options
Be wary of pre-checked boxes or unclear consent mechanisms
Use tools like Incognito Browser to limit tracking regardless of policies
Regularly review your privacy settings as policies can change
Consider the reputation of the company and their privacy track record

interpretation.label: Low Risk (A)
interpretation.description: The privacy policy demonstrates good privacy practices with clear language, limited data collection, and strong user rights.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk (B)
interpretation.description: Generally acceptable privacy practices with some areas for improvement. Review settings carefully.

interpretation.label: Elevated Risk (C)
interpretation.description: Several privacy concerns present. Take extra precautions and limit data sharing where possible.

interpretation.label: High Risk (D)
interpretation.description: Significant privacy risks identified. Consider alternatives or use additional privacy protection tools.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk (F)
interpretation.description: Major privacy concerns present. Strongly consider avoiding this service or use maximum privacy protections.
